version.description: Semver of this rule's check logic — see spec §3

category.description: Rule category: discovery, documentation, actionability, machine_readable, verification

severity.description: Rule severity: high (triggers category floor), medium (normal), low (informational). Note: 'critical' is intentionally excluded from v0.1 — see spec §A.3

counted_in_score.description: If false, this rule does not contribute to score calculation

applicability.description: Optional applicability condition — if absent, rule always applies

description.description: Human-readable description of when this rule applies

type.description: Check type: http_fetch (HTTP GET + parse), schema_validation (validate against JSON Schema), exact_match (string/structural equality), cross_evidence (compare two fetched sources on shared key)

sources.description: Array of source identifiers to fetch/compare (for http_fetch, cross_evidence)

match_keys.description: Keys to match when type = exact_match or cross_evidence

conflict_when.description: Condition expression describing when sources conflict (for cross_evidence)

target.description: Target path or URL for http_fetch / schema_validation

check.description: Check definition — how the rule is evaluated

pillar.description: Optional pillar override — if absent, pillar is derived from category via CATEGORY_TO_PILLAR map (spec v0.2 §A.8)

eligible.description: Whether AgentBadge can generate a fix for this rule

type.description: Fix type: deterministic (safe to auto-generate), assisted (requires human confirm/edit/reject), none (not fixable by AgentBadge)

note.description: Additional context about the fix approach

fix.description: Fix definition — how a failing rule can be remediated
